1956Research report

Symbolic AI

The Logic Theory Machine

Heuristic search made symbolic theorem proving a concrete computational task.

Allen Newell and Herbert A. Simon

The contribution

This report describes a program that searched for proofs in symbolic logic. It used heuristics to select promising lines of reasoning rather than exhaustively enumerating every possibility, illustrating an early approach to automated problem solving.

What this does not establish

Its achievements concerned a restricted formal problem domain. They did not demonstrate unrestricted reasoning about the everyday world.

Why this date?

The linked RAND report is dated 12 July 1956.

This entry follows the linked publication. Read the source and date conventions.
